prior_exposure: Browser views near 25, 50 and 75 s; native frame near 50 s inspected before this sampling plan. Not a blind selection.
sampling: Independent timestamp seeks via existing reader, recording returned frame indices and timestamps; no claim of sequential full-video coverage.
purpose: Check framing, source context, image detail and scene cuts; retain regional human role separately. No detector execution or exact pixel truth.
retention: One lossless native main frame; all selected native pixel hashes and a half-size context contact sheet. Other selected native arrays are transient.
